exposure: Systemic vasculitis (Takayasu arteritis, Behcet disease, antineutrophil cytoplasmic antibody-associated vasculitis, Kawasaki disease)
outcome: Preterm delivery (PTD) subtypes (preterm premature rupture of membranes, spontaneous PTD, early PTD [20-31 weeks], PTD [32-36 weeks])
cohort: The study included 96 first-time births to nulliparous patients with systemic vasculitis, compared with 4,191,900 births of the nulliparous general population without a history of rheumatic disease.
finding: First-time births to patients with systemic vasculitis have a significantly elevated risk of preterm delivery subtypes and hypertensive disorders of pregnancy compared to the general birthing population.
